역대상 8:1.content: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

역대상 8:2.content: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

역대상 8:3.content: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,

역대상 8:4.content: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,

역대상 8:5.content: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

역대상 8:6.content: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:

역대상 8:7.content: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.

역대상 8:8.content: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

역대상 8:9.content: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,

역대상 8:10.content: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.

역대상 8:11.content: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.

역대상 8:12.content: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:

역대상 8:13.content: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:

역대상 8:15.content: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

역대상 8:16.content: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;

역대상 8:17.content: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,

역대상 8:18.content: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

역대상 8:19.content: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

역대상 8:20.content: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

역대상 8:21.content: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;

역대상 8:22.content: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,

역대상 8:23.content: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,

역대상 8:24.content: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,

역대상 8:25.content: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

역대상 8:26.content: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

역대상 8:27.content: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

역대상 8:28.content: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.

역대상 8:29.content: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:

역대상 8:30.content: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

역대상 8:31.content: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

역대상 8:32.content: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.

역대상 8:33.content: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.

역대상 8:34.content: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal; and Merib–baal begat Micah.

역대상 8:35.content: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.

역대상 8:36.content: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,

역대상 8:37.content: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:

역대상 8:38.content: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

역대상 8:39.content: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

역대상 8:40.content: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
